sentences.text: Heard Ms. R. Islam, the learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. M. P.
Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam and Mr. P. Page No.# 2/2 Saikia, learned Legal Aid Counsel for the respondent No. 2.
By this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C., the petitioner, namely, Zakir Hussain is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with Bogiribari Police Station Case No. 140/2023 under Section Zakinur Hussain vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155938182/

sentences.text: Case diary as called for has been received and perused the same.
Considered the materials so far collected by the Investigating Officer.
Perused the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. and under Section 161 of Cr.P.C. Also perused the statement of other witnesses recorded by the I.O.
The victim has specifically implicated the accused.
There are sufficient incriminating materials against the present petitioner.
Considering the nature of material collected by the I.O., as well as the gravity of the offence, this Court is not inclined to grant privilege of pre-arrest bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, this bail application is disposed of.
